description_expanded: Description Description 30A Beach House rental, Parkside on 30A, located in Santa Rosa Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Free Activities Included — see details below*** FEATURES* 5-Bedroom Beach House on 30A* Living Area (First Floor) - Smart TV with Cable, Queen Sleeper Sofa* Living Area (Second Floor) - Smart TV with Cable, Queen Sleeper Sofa* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 (First Floor) - King Bed, 42" Smart TV with Cable, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 2 (Second Floor) - Queen Bed, 42" Smart TV with Cable, En Suite Bathroom* Bedroom 3 (Second Floor) - Queen Bed, 42" Smart TV with Cable* Bathroom 3 (Second Floor) - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 4 (Second Floor) - Queen Bed, 42" Smart TV with Cable* Bedroom 5 (Second Floor) - Queen Bed, 42" Smart TV with Cable* Half Bathroom (First Floor)* Washer/Dryer* Outdoor Shower* Electric Grill* Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi* Sleeps Up to 14 guests Security Device: Exterior camera located at the front door. 30A Beach Access Points COMMUNITY AMENITIESZero-Entry Resort-Style PoolPool House with TV & SeatingOutdoor Kitchen with Grill & SinkGas Fire PitScenic BoardwalkConvenient Public Beach Access Nearby Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, starter laundry detergent, each bathroom includes starter amenities (similar to a hotel, but not restocked), shampoo, conditioner, soap bar, and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach.
